tasks.title: Gather with the Council of Magical Creatures
tasks.description: Attend a briefing with the Council of Magical Creatures to discuss the recent surge in unicorn poaching incidents and decide on increasing protective wards in enchanted forests.

tasks.title: Sanction Potion-Making License Regulations
tasks.description: Approve the new regulations for potion-making licenses, particularly concerning the restriction of volatile ingredients in student potions classes based on Professor Morgana's recommendations.

tasks.title: Convene with the Magical Transportation Department
tasks.description: Meet with the Department of Magical Transportation to finalize the approval of a new Floo Network expansion that connects remote wizarding villages to major magical cities.

tasks.title: Review Defense Ward Enchantment Upgrades
tasks.description: Oversee the enchantment upgrades for the Ministry’s Defense Wards due to reports of weakening in certain areas and review them urgently.

tasks.title: Ratify the Magical Education Reform Bill
tasks.description: Review and sign off on the Magical Education Reform Bill to include non-traditional magic forms like Wandless Casting and Potionless Healing into the curriculum.

tasks.title: Convene with Auror Command
tasks.description: Hold a closed-door session with the Auror Command to discuss the increasing threat posed by rogue magical factions and coordinate a response plan.

tasks.title: Survey Time-Turner Research Progress
tasks.description: Inspect the progress of the Time-Turner Research Unit as they work to stabilize safe time travel spells due to incidents of wizards disappearing for longer than expected.

tasks.title: Host Luncheon with Enchanted Isles Delegation
tasks.description: Host a diplomatic luncheon with the visiting delegation from the Enchanted Isles to strengthen alliances and negotiate the safe exchange of rare magical artifacts.

tasks.title: Authorize Veela Community Relocation
tasks.description: Sign off on the relocation order for the Veela community whose habitat has been encroached upon by Muggle construction, with alternative sanctuary locations prepared by the Department of Magical Creatures.

tasks.title: Gather Counter-Curse Progress Report
tasks.description: Receive a progress report from the Spell Innovation Bureau tasked with developing new counter-curses for recent dark spell variants discovered in the northern territories.
